description: Fresh original-language Ancient Greek prose from eight authors absent from the original six-author pilot: 18 reference works, five calibration-only unfamiliar-author works, and three final unfamiliar-author works. No classification or model scoring was run by the curator.
selection_protocol: Source-only selection before new-corpus scoring. Roles were predeclared by the root agent based on author IDs and corpus availability. Select complete independently catalogued compositions, not chapters treated as separate works. Use the three Aeschines speeches; six first substantial Isaeus inheritance speeches (exclude the fourth because its body has fewer than 2000 tokens); six authentic conventional Plutarch moral/religious essays and Delphic dialogues; three separately catalogued Dionysius compositions (On Thucydides, On Literary Composition, Letter to Pompeius). Calibration unfamiliar writers are the two authentic Antiphon homicide speeches and the first three catalogue-numbered Aelius Aristides prose hymns. Final unfamiliar authors are the first two Andocides speeches and Galen On the Natural Faculties as one whole work. All reference works exceed 2000 normalized tokens. No text, author, threshold or feature selection used classification performance.
role_assignment_basis: Initially Antiphon was proposed as a reference author. Source research found specific attribution doubts about Against the Stepmother; before any scoring that work was excluded, Antiphon was moved to calibration_unknown, and Dionysius moved to reference because three independent cleanly catalogued works were available. The change was prompted solely by source authenticity and work availability, not model results.

freshness.curator_actions: Downloaded primary source bytes, inspected catalogue and attribution material, ran existing text extraction, token counts, duplicate/source-ID and checksum audits only. No classifier fitting, predictions, feature analysis or benchmark execution.
freshness.caveat: Metadata and selected prose were inspected for curation. Fresh means unexposed to model-performance evaluation at acquisition; it does not mean anonymous or unread by a curator. Subsequent evaluation exposure must be recorded by the evaluator.

attribution_caveat: Eight author labels are conventional catalogue assumptions, not historically certain identities. This is a small convenience sample with four candidate/reference authors, two calibration unfamiliar authors, and two final unfamiliar authors; they are not eight independent candidate identities or eight unknown-author trials. One final unfamiliar writer (Galen) contributes just one work. Corpus breadth, genre, subject, chronology, editing and quotation remain confounded. Success would not establish named scripture attribution, author counts, Biblical/Koine transfer, or reliability for Hebrew/Arabic. Final test authors and works must not be used to tune decision thresholds.
known_disputed_works_excluded: Antiphon Against the Stepmother for Poisoning (specific historical authenticity/exercise doubts)
Andocides On the Peace with Sparta (modern authenticity dispute)
Pseudo-Plutarch On the Education of Children, On Music, Lives of the Ten Orators
Epictetus discourses as a label for his recorder Arrian
label_policy: Manual broad genre/topic labels, not independently validated topic matching. Court oratory crosses reference Aeschines/Isaeus, calibration Antiphon and final Andocides. Aelius Aristides prose hymns and Plutarch religious essays/dialogues share a broad topic but differ in genre.
parser_policy: Use existing unchanged tei-greek-v1 extractor: single Greek edition, omitting marked notes/headings/editorial matter/quotations and retaining accepted readings. No model-dependent cleaning. No books or chunks promoted into independent work labels.
